tonight.headline: Jets D/ST in; Rice and Jacobs still wait on practice
body: Bad news first: there is still no practice report behind Rashee Rice's return — the Chiefs said on 16 Oct they expect him back, but he has not been seen practising — and Green Bay can keep Josh Jacobs on his roster exemption through Monday without playing him.

The Jets D/ST went in for the Patriots this morning, free. The lineup projects 122.0 against Furia Regia's 111.6, 55% on ESPN; the projection lineup is 1.1 higher on two coin flips that wait for Thursday and Friday's reports.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Rice or Jacobs moved in on hope and then inactive with no executable fallback. Pickens plays Monday, so Rice's is safe; Gordon locks at 11:00 before Green Bay's 12:55 inactives, so Jacobs's is not.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Furia Regia replacing McLaurin (season-ending, still in their lineup) with Justin Jefferson from their bench — about 18.6 more on their side.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off the Exempt List Monday; practises from Wednesday for 'a full week of work'; LaFleur: 'to be determined', 'possible' (Packers.com 19 Oct). His roster exemption runs to 26 Oct, so Green Bay can hold him out of Sunday without a roster move (DK Network 20 Oct).

case.label: Contested
case.body: SI (18 Oct) and Pelissero say he starts immediately when he plays. That is a role claim; LaFleur's word is about availability. I take LaFleur's side until a practice report says otherwise.

case.label: The timing
case.body: Gordon kicks off at 11:00; Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55. If Jacobs starts and is inactive, no running back on this bench can replace him.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Packers report shows no designation after full Thursday and Friday practices. Any designation, or no clear word by Sunday 10:30, and Gordon stays.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Gordon outscores Jacobs (archive).

case.body: 13.5 against 13.3: inside the two-point line, so the projection decides and no thesis is written.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Hamstring and knee since Week 4; ruled out of Week 6 as a precaution, with the Chiefs expecting him back for Week 7 (Field Level Media 16 Oct). No 2026 practice participation found — a designation is a label; practice is the evidence.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Limited or full practice by Friday and no OUT tag: swap him in for Pickens. If he is inactive at 16:50 Sunday, swap Pickens back — his game is Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Pickens outscores Rice (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Jacobs contingency would fire too late
whatWentWrong.lead: It says check at 12:55 Sunday; Gordon's game starts at 11:00.

case.label: What happened
case.body: lineup_check.py prints 'if inactive at Sun 12:55 CDMX, start Gordon' — but Gordon is locked by then. Followed literally, an inactive Jacobs scores zero.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Gordon stays in; Jacobs comes in only on Friday's evidence (the first card above). Rice's contingency does not have the problem: Pickens plays Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: ESPN's lock in this league is per-slot rather than per-player — it is not; a started player cannot be benched.

whatWentWrong.sources: lineup_check.py output · ESPN league file kickoffs

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 9.9 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Stroud's 23.0 sat behind Daniels's 19.0; Worthy's 14.3 behind Garrett Wilson's 8.4.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 150.8 to 88.62 over Los Cachanillas; best possible 160.7 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost — no override, nothing to fix but to keep starting by projection, which is why Rice's card waits on practice rather than on a hunch.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A projection-set Week 7 lineup leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).

lineupCheck.verdict: 1.1 below the projection lineup on two coin flips — Rice over Pickens (0.2) and Jacobs over Gordon (0.9); both wait on this week's practice reports.

moves.reason: Not a value call — a timing one, carried from Tuesday. Jacobs has not practised since August; his roster exemption runs to 26 Oct and LaFleur calls Sunday 'to be determined' (Packers.com 19 Oct; DK Network 20 Oct, after Monday's projection). Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55 CDMX, after Gordon's 11:00 kickoff, so the printed contingency cannot execute. Reverts to Jacobs if Friday's report clears him.
